items.text: Saquon Barkley listed OUT on ETR Sunday injury board along with Tank Bigsby and DeVonta Smith; confirmed by team report and insiders.
items.implication: Eagles RB room thin; start/sit pivots needed.
items.opportunity: Lead back snaps/carries open for remaining backs

items.text: Lamar Jackson ruled OUT for Sunday night vs Falcons with left ankle injury; Huntley to start. Also OUT: Trey Hendrickson, Cam Jurgens.
items.implication: Ravens offense downgrade; Flowers/Likely/Henry usage shifts possible.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Zay Flowers, Isaiah Likely if present

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels will start vs Giants; WR Stefon Diggs OUT (hamstring).
items.why: Diggs hamstring; Daniels cleared/full after elbow.
items.implication: Daniels return upgrades WAS offense; Diggs absence opens WR targets.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/targets for Terry McLaurin, Deebo Samuel if available

items.text: Ashton Jeanty listed QUESTIONABLE on ETR board; Rapoport confirms Raiders Q designation.
items.implication: Monitor for game-time; backup RB opportunity if OUT.
items.opportunity: If OUT, carries open in LV backfield

items.text: Breece Hall listed OUT on ETR board (quad, 2nd straight miss); also AD Mitchell.
items.implication: NYJ RB committee or backup lead.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans off injury report with no designation (ACTIVE/clear); Juszczyk and Bosa OUT.
items.implication: Full WR role expected vs SEA.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love not on final injury report (IN); Levitan projects much bigger workload/role this week despite ankle maintenance, 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier. Gut says better role after Week 4 criticism.
items.why: Ankle maintenance but full-go comments; not on final report; prior low usage backlash.
items.opportunity: Expanded carries, snaps, goal-line work vs Allgeier

items.text: Chargers ruled out WR Quentin Johnston (among others including OT Joe Alt, S Derwin James).
items.implication: LAC WR targets consolidate to McConkey/others.
items.opportunity: Route/target share increase for Ladd McConkey

items.text: Broncos place WR Pat Bryant on short-term IR (ankle); will miss next 4 games, return eligible Nov 8. Promoted Lil’Jordan Humphrey.
items.opportunity: Targets to Courtland Sutton, Jaylen Waddle, others

items.text: Levitan flags long-term multi-risk for Malik Nabers (knee issue, shoulder, potential QB change to McCarthy, coaching); good this week but sideways potential later. Frustration over low 2H targets noted.
items.implication: Hold short-term but monitor ROS value.

items.text: Matthew Berry LOVES Nico Collins @ TEN as his WR8; high volume including red zone vs soft matchup.
items.why: Target-hog volume + red-zone + Titans defense struggles vs WR.

items.text: Berry LOVES Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; workload + soft run defense, boosted if Bengals WRs limited.
items.why: Solid workload vs defense carved by RBs; Bengals injury context.
items.opportunity: Carries + potential pass-game if Chase/Higgins out

items.text: Berry HATES Jordan Addison @ NO (WR41); tough matchup, thin role, injury wrinkle.
Berry HATES Cam Skattebo @ WSH (RB20) and Tony Pollard vs HOU (RB28) over efficiency and game environment concerns.
items.why: Poor efficiency spots and unfavorable scripts.
